objective: Certificar sin desarrollo el cierre de seguridad/RBAC y limpieza de Cavas en Development. Auditar permisos y modulos Cava existentes, resolucion de scope multiunidad, protecciones 403/404/409 ya implementadas, aislamiento por unidad, Persona-Link, cero residuos UAT, baseline del canario y FKs. No crear ni modificar roles, usuarios, permisos, menus, tablas, datos ni codigo. Reportar blockers reales sin corregirlos.

queries.name: cava_rbac_modules
queries.sql: SELECT ModuloID,CodigoModulo,NombreModulo,TipoModulo,Ruta,EsVisibleMenu,Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_Modulos WHERE CodigoModulo=N'cava_socios' OR CodigoModulo LIKE N'cava_socios.%' ORDER BY CodigoModulo;

queries.name: cava_rbac_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT m.CodigoModulo,p.RolID,p.AccionID,p.Permitido,p.RestriccionPropietario,p.RestriccionSucursal,p.RequiereAutorizacion,p.NivelAutorizacionRequerido,p.Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo p JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos m ON m.ModuloID=p.ModuloID WHERE (m.CodigoModulo=N'cava_socios' OR m.CodigoModulo LIKE N'cava_socios.%') AND p.Activo=1 ORDER BY m.CodigoModulo,p.RolID,p.AccionID;

queries.name: uat_personas_zero
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona WHERE RFC LIKE N'UAT13B%';

queries.name: uat_bottles_zero
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas WHERE ProductoNombre LIKE N'UAT13B-%' OR ProductoCodigo LIKE N'UAT13B-%';

queries.name: uat_movements_zero
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos WHERE Observaciones LIKE N'UAT13B-%' OR MotivoMovimiento LIKE N'CAVAS-GATE13B-%';

queries.name: uat_cargos_zero
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos WHERE ConceptoCargo LIKE N'%UAT13B-%';

queries.name: canary_baseline
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS UnidadNegocioID,NumeroSocio,PersonaID,ClienteCRMID,Estatus,Activo FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');

queries.name: cava_fk
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS child_table,name,is_disabled,is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE parent_object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos')) ORDER BY child_table,name;

constraints: No changes to RBAC roles permissions users menus companies or units
Do not seed or repair permissions in this job
Fail closed if any UAT residue remains
Fail closed if any FK is disabled or untrusted
Report blockers exactly; do not fix them
EDARSAHUB SQL Server remains source of truth
MongoDB prohibited as source of truth
